s1.title: 1. Acceptance of terms
s1.body: By creating a Tabla account, you agree to these Terms of Service and our Privacy, Refund, and Cookies policies. If you do not agree, do not use Tabla.

s2.title: 2. Your account
s2.body: You are responsible for keeping your password safe and for all activity under your account. You must provide accurate billing information and a working contact email.

s3.title: 3. Acceptable use
s3.body: You may not use Tabla to publish illegal content, infringe intellectual property, run phishing or fraud, or interfere with other tenants. We may suspend any restaurant violating these rules.

s4.title: 4. Payments and subscriptions
s4.body: Theme purchases are processed by Paymob. Prices are in the currency shown at checkout. You authorise us to charge the chosen payment method for the amount displayed at the time of purchase.

s5.title: 5. Service availability
s5.body: We aim for high availability but do not guarantee uninterrupted service. Scheduled maintenance and incidents may occur.

s6.title: 6. Limitation of liability
s6.body: Tabla is provided as-is. Our total liability for any claim is capped at the amounts you paid in the 12 months preceding the claim.

s1.title: 1. Data we collect
s1.body: We collect: account data (email, name), restaurant data you enter, payment metadata (no card numbers — those live with Paymob), order metadata (no diner card data, no GPS), and diagnostic logs.

s2.title: 2. How we use it
s2.body: To operate the service, send transactional emails (receipts, password resets), prevent abuse, and improve features. We never sell your data.

s3.title: 3. Sharing with vendors
s3.body: We use: Supabase (database), Cloudflare R2 (image storage), Upstash (rate limiting), Paymob (payments), Resend (transactional email), Cloudflare Turnstile (bot protection), Sentry (error monitoring). Each vendor has its own privacy policy.

s4.title: 4. Your rights
s4.body: You can access, export, correct, or delete your data from your account page. We respond to verified requests within 30 days.

s5.title: 5. Retention
s5.body: Account and order data is retained while your account is active. After deletion, we hard-delete within 14 days except where required for legal records (e.g., financial transactions, kept for 7 years).

s6.title: 6. International transfers
s6.body: Data may be processed outside your country by the vendors above. We rely on standard contractual clauses where applicable.

s1.title: 1. Theme purchases
s1.body: Theme purchases are refundable within 14 days of purchase if the theme has not been used to publish a public menu, or in the event of a verified product defect.

s2.title: 2. How to request a refund
s2.body: Email support@tabla.app with your account email and order id. We will respond within 3 business days and process approved refunds within 7 business days.

s3.title: 3. Refund method
s3.body: Refunds are issued to the original payment method via Paymob. Bank processing may add 5–10 business days before the refund appears on your statement.

s4.title: 4. Chargebacks
s4.body: Please contact us first. Issuing an unjustified chargeback may result in account suspension and recovery of associated fees.

s1.title: 1. What we use
s1.body: Strictly necessary cookies: session (Auth.js), CSRF protection, locale preference. These cannot be disabled and we do not store them for analytics.

s2.title: 2. Third-party cookies
s2.body: Cloudflare Turnstile uses a cookie to verify you are not a bot. Google sets cookies during OAuth sign-in if you choose that method.

s3.title: 3. Your choices
s3.body: You can clear cookies in your browser at any time. Clearing the session cookie will sign you out.

items.q: Do diners need to install an app?
items.a: No. The menu opens in their phone's browser straight from the QR. Order handoff happens in WhatsApp, which most users already have.
Two modes. Default: the order is sent to your WhatsApp and you collect at the table. Optional: enable Paymob to take card / wallet inside the menu.

items.q: Can I use my own colors and fonts?
items.a: Yes. Each theme exposes primary, secondary and accent. Studio plans get custom fonts and full CSS overrides.

items.q: What does the QR code look like?
items.a: Brandable. You pick the colors, embed your logo in the centre, choose rounded or square modules, and export as PNG / SVG / PDF.
